en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1247 - Hisham ibn al-Hakam narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

regarding a man who wishes to perform an act of goodness, such as giving charity or fasting.
Imam (as) said: "It is recommended that it be done on Jumu’ah, for deeds performed on Jumu’ah are multiplied."
